(() => { const p=document.querySelector('#dataset .iso-stage'); for(let i=0;i<3;i++) p.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'ArrowRight',bubbles:true})); if(p.getAttribute('aria-valuenow')!=='4') throw Error('rapid key navigation'); return 'rapid keys: passed'; })()

(async () => { for(const p of document.querySelectorAll('.stream')) { for(let i=0;i<6;i++){p.querySelectorAll('.step')[i].click(); if(p.querySelector('.iso-stage').getAttribute('aria-valuenow')!==String(i+1)) throw Error('stage aria mismatch'); if(!p.querySelectorAll('.step')[i].classList.contains('selected')) throw Error('selection mismatch'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); } } return '12 stages: passed'; })()

(() => { if(document.querySelector('#dataset .iso-stage').getAttribute('aria-valuenow')!=='1') throw Error('tour resume did not wrap from final stage'); return 'tour resumes from selection: passed'; })()
